label: sec:categorical-lagrangian-intro
html: The categorical Dirac operator \mathcal{D}_ abla combines with a state \psi \colon \mathbf{1} o A to form the endomorphism of A that will be traced to yield the action. The categorical Lagrangian \mathcal{L}_q( abla, \psi) = \mathcal{D}_ abla^2 + \psi^* \otimes \mathcal{D}_ abla\psi \in \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A) packages the bosonic and fermionic sectors before trace-integration. This endomorphism exists uniquely once abla, \psi, q, and \xi are chosen.
